decisions.reason: Because this devore decoration fabric was only visibly marketed at launch and not shown thereafter, management would view demand as sufficiently revealed and too weak to justify continued catalogue and warehouse space for another close-to-core option.
Since the transparent burnout decorative fabric appeared only in 2019, the firm would infer that market feedback did not warrant keeping this low-differentiation option open beyond the trial period.

With no continued website presence after launch, this burnout decorative fabric likely failed to show enough traction relative to the firm's other similar offerings, so the option should be abandoned.
Although adjacent to the core upholstery range, the velour-like fabric seems to have delivered enough information by 2021 without proving lasting value, so resources are better reallocated.
The flame-retardant plain inbetween fabric built on the established offer but was not sustained in later market presentation, suggesting the option's upside was not strong enough to keep it active.

As the polyester lining fabric with satin sheen was only presented at introduction and not maintained afterward, management would likely close this option and redeploy inventory and attention to stronger lines.
